say:2:1530444001:1.text: Well, besides knowing how to make soup, the only thing I've got left is a good mindset.
say:2:1530444001:1.source_cn: 除了熬汤的手艺，我也就剩一个好心态了。

say:3:1530444002:1.text: I make soup because folks get hungry. And when you're hungry, nothing soothes you like soup.
say:3:1530444002:1.source_cn: 熬汤是因为大家会饿，会饿就会想喝汤。

say:4:1530444003:1.text: But it takes the right mindset to make good soup... it's what brings out the flavor.
say:4:1530444003:1.source_cn: 好心态……是因为，只要心态好，才能熬出好喝的汤。
